# Kome.Reconcile known-answer vectors. Read by tests/test_reconcile.adb.
# DESIGN.md §8 (D13), all integers big-endian:
#   OPEN  = 05 || proto (01) || ns[16] || n_rv:u8 || n_rv x frame[275]
#   HELLO = 01 || n_auth:u32 || n_data:u32 || digest[32] || cred_len:u16 || cred
# Built with Python's struct from the layout above, independently of the
# SPARK code (the frames and credentials are opaque bytes here):
#   open  = b'\x05\x01' + ns + bytes([n]) + frames
#   hello = b'\x01' + struct.pack('>II', na, nd) + dg + struct.pack('>H', len(cr)) + cr
# Formats:
#   open  <ns, 16-byte hex> <frames concatenated, hex, or -> <wire, hex>
#   hello <n_auth> <n_data> <digest, 32-byte hex> <cred, hex, or -> <wire, hex>
